title: NV-Retriever: Improving text embedding models with effective hard-negative mining
authors: Gabriel de Souza P. Moreira; Radek Osmulski; Mengyao Xu; Ronay Ak; Benedikt Schifferer; Even Oldridge
why_relevant: Addresses hard-negative mining and false negative filtering for training embedding retrievers, tangentially related to retrieval quality which underlies RAG robustness.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on improving embedding model training, not on robustness of RAG to unreliable evidence, conflict, attacks, or calibration.
